messages:
yasmin: Postmortem follow-up: same autoscale/headroom pattern reappeared during yesterday's traffic surge. We need owners, minimal scopes, and short deadlines.

oliver: I can take the scheduler-side work. Plan: add preempt debounce + reduce aggressive reclaim windows. Will propose concrete vals in PR.

trent: I'll handle quota backstops and the emergency reserve pool. Want a conservative default we can tune later.

pagerbot: Created tasks: GPU-1509 (reserve-pool), GPU-1510 (scheduler-debounce), GPU-1511 (alerts+runbook), GPU-1512 (surge-ci-job).

zara: I'll take alerts and runbook. Alerts fired during the tail; need a warning tier and a fast mitigation checklist.

oliver: Draft scheduler changes (short):
```
- preempt_debounce_ms: 6000
- reclaim_window: 8s -> 15s soft-window
- prefer_local_affinity: true for latency queues
```
I'll add perf graphs to the PR and a 4-hour canary plan.

trent: Reserve pool proposal: 7% of cluster GPUs reserved for premium/system traffic, with per-org opt-out. Rollback flag mandatory. Target rollout 2026-04-12.

zara: Alert plan: warning at 70% committed GPUs, recoverable steps (scale down noncritical jobs). Critical at 92% -> page oncall + infra lead. I'll draft runbook steps.

yasmin: Owners & deadlines recap:
- GPU-1509 trent (reserve pool + opt-out) -> 2026-04-12
- GPU-1510 oliver (scheduler debounce PR + canary) -> 2026-03-31
- GPU-1511 zara (alerts + runbook) -> 2026-03-29
- GPU-1512 yasmin (synthetic surge CI job) -> 2026-03-28

trent: Cost guardrail note: finance-bot confirmed temporary reserve is approved for up to 6 weeks if cost delta <12%. finance-bot: Approved pending final rollback plan.

oliver: Canary details: 4h staging, 6h prod limited to one region. Health gates: preemption rate <= baseline*1.2, tail latency no worse than 10%.

yasmin: Also adding recurring 15-min incident-pattern sync for 4 weeks to monitor. pagerbot: Create calendar invite?

pagerbot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-26T13:30Z. Invite created for owners.

zara: I'll add CI surge job that runs a 20m mixed-seq spike and reports to the alerts dashboard; failing tests should block merge.

trent: I'll add an automated rollback trigger if cost delta >12% or if customer opt-outs exceed 10% of dedicated tenants.

yasmin: Thanks — I'll aggregate these into the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping assignees tomorrow morning. :+1:
